notablePrerequisites:
"Dragons" chosen with Palace Siege.
You control at least two Zombies.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Palace Siege and Endless Ranks of the Dead trigger.
Resolve the Palace Siege trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Resolve the Endless Ranks of the Dead trigger, creating at least one 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Razaketh by paying 2 life and sacrificing a Zombie token, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuflle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.
